notes: Snapshot FY2026 (year ended Mar 31, 2026). The BRSR is the SEBI-mandated Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report, released by Biocon as a data book with the Integrated Annual Report FY2026 (tier filing); its boundary is Biocon Limited plus Biocon Biologics Limited (India and Malaysia) and excludes Syngene. Unlike the FY2024 edition, which gave one combined table naming the plants, the FY2026 BRSR gives separate national/international tables for Biocon Limited (5 plants, 1 office in India; 1 plant, 6 offices abroad) and Biocon Biologics (2 plants, 1 office in India; 1 plant, 17 offices abroad) without naming locations, so each entity is its own metric and the counts are not added (the BRSR doesn't say whether locations overlap). International counts are a region row. The BRSR says Biocon Limited serves 60+ countries and Biocon Biologics 120+, with no per-country counts. No employees or taxes by country found. Sites come from the FY2026 Integrated Annual Report's own descriptions (the generics manufacturing table, the subsidiary notes and highlights); the report also lists Biocon Campus, Bengaluru, and Biocon Generics Inc in New Jersey, and Biocon Biologics' biosimilars network in India and Malaysia. Syngene's sites are not listed.
